guidance: Be clear on inclusions and exclusions. Keep commercial language professional and specific. Prefer compact tables for timeline and investment when listing several items. Do not invent legal terms, payment schedules, or rates the user did not provide.

outline.title: Project Summary
outline.guidance: Frame client goals and your approach.

children.title: Client Goals
children.guidance: What the client is ultimately trying to achieve.

children.title: Our Approach
children.guidance: Brief summary of how the work will solve their problem.

children.title: Deliverable
children.guidance: Title each instance with the deliverable or phase name.

children.title: Exclusions
children.guidance: What is explicitly not included. Omit if none.

children.title: Milestone
children.guidance: Title each instance with the milestone name.

children.title: Target Date
children.guidance: When this milestone is reached, or a relative window if dates are unset.

children.title: Line Item
children.guidance: Title each instance with the service line name.

children.title: Service Cost
children.guidance: Price or pricing basis for this part. Use a small table if multiple components share one line.
